goal.objective: Implement and locally verify the authorized keep-working safeguards in the canonical prevalentWare/opencode-goal-plugin source, starting from published commit b5a6c6a0449a213c29ff34ea2d07c4ccbd351725: prevent unsupported premature `unmet` closure with a goal/plan-revision-bound stop audit and resumable waiting, remove implicit handback limits for unbudgeted goals while preserving explicit limits and permission boundaries, and add regression plus isolated V2 lifecycle coverage. Do not deploy, activate in the live OpenCode runtime, publish, commit, or push; those remain separate approvals/follow-up.

plan.summary: Implement and verify goal-level stop-audit and keep-working safeguards in the pinned upstream source. Preserve explicit limits, user cancellation, platform permissions and the live runtime boundary; local implementation does not imply deployment or publication.
completionCriteria: The central lifecycle path rejects `unmet` closure unless a structured audit is current for the goal ID and plan revision, represents the full unfinished plan and specific external blocker, includes concrete sourced evidence and alternatives, and no reasonable in-scope authorized work remains; marking every task blocked or supplying generic blocker prose is insufficient.
A genuine external dependency can be recorded as resumable waiting on the same goal without terminal `unmet`; explicit user pause/cancel and verified completion continue to behave correctly.

Unbudgeted goals have no hidden automatic turn/duration/low-output handback ceiling; meaningful tool/evidence/task progress is recognized, stalls trigger bounded diagnosis/recovery with backoff rather than handback or tight loops, and explicit user/platform limits remain enforced.

Regression coverage reproduces premature-stop-while-independent-preparation-remains, stale audits and concurrent plan changes, blocked phase vs independent work, all-blocked claims, existing authorization, tool-only progress, >25 turns, transient failures, pause/cancel, Plan mode and explicit budgets/permissions.
Plugin lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, build, package checks and an isolated V2 lifecycle smoke test pass; no live runtime activation, publish, commit or push is performed.

tasks.description: Enforce current audit and whole-plan exhaustion atomically at the central lifecycle mutation so every tool/command/direct API path is covered; persist audit evidence and reject stale/concurrent bypasses.

tasks.description: Represent genuine external dependency as a resumable nonterminal state on the same goal with clear blocker, distinct from terminal audited `unmet`.
tasks.evidence: waiting persists the same goal as paused with stopReason external dependency, blocker, and closure audit; state tests verify persisted identity and successful resume without clearing the dependency context.

phases.verification: Current audit scope is validated atomically at closure; stale/concurrent changes and remaining work are rejected, and external waits remain resumable on the same goal.

phases.objective: Remove implicit handback for unbudgeted goals while preserving explicit constraints and safe bounded recovery.

tasks.description: Eliminate default 25-turn/duration and short-output stopping for unbudgeted goals while honoring explicit user and platform limits.
tasks.evidence: Unspecified auto-turn, duration, prompt-failure, and no-progress limits now remain null; explicit limits remain enforced. State tests verify 30 unbudgeted turns and continuing after five unbudgeted prompt failures.

tasks.description: Count tool activity, verified evidence and plan advancement as progress independent of response length; trigger diagnosis and changed strategy for stalls.
tasks.evidence: Tool output and plan updates increment continuation progress independently of response length; tests verify tool and plan progress reset no-progress accounting and unrelated assistant observations do not consume it.

tasks.description: Recover transient continuation/transport failures with exponential or otherwise bounded backoff, avoiding tight loops and preserving deliberate waiting when external input is required.
tasks.evidence: Continuation retry/stall delays use increasing backoff capped at 60 seconds or the configured minimum interval, with explicit failure ceilings preserved. Server tests verify increasing retry spacing, minimum interval, and configured failure limits.

phases.verification: Hidden defaults were removed while explicit limits remain enforced; tool/plan progress is recognized and failure/stall retries back off. Tests cover >25 turns, low-output tool progress, explicit failure limits, and retry spacing.

phases.objective: Add failure-reproducing tests and explain the new audit, waiting and continuation behavior in the plugin's user/developer documentation.

The central lifecycle now requires a current goal/plan-revision-bound audit for waiting/unmet, rejects remaining or actionable work, preserves resumable external waits, and allows terminal unmet only with sourced impossibility evidence. No deployment, live-runtime activation, publication, commit, or push occurred.
